analysis:
## Technical analysis

**Trend:** NVDA remains in a recovery channel from the $142.03 52-week low, but the rally has stalled in a $188–$200 consolidation range for the past two weeks. The May 14 ATH at $236.54 is $38.22 away — meaningful overhead supply exists at every $10 increment ($200, $210, $220). Today's close of $198.32 keeps NVDA inside this consolidation box.

**Momentum:** RSI estimated ~52 (neutral; not overbought). The quarter-end +1.72% day is welcome but did not produce a momentum breakout — volume at ~185M shares is below the >200M threshold required for a re-entry signal. MACD is flat-positive, suggesting consolidation rather than trending impulse.

**Volume:** ~185M shares traded — below average. This is critical: the re-entry gate explicitly requires above-average volume (>200M) on a $200+ close. Today's volume confirms the market is not yet prepared to make a sustained commitment above $200. Quarter-end rebalancing flows inflate the volume denominator for recent sessions.

**Key levels with evidence:**
- **★ Strongest resistance: $200.** Acted as the precise intraday high lid ($200.01) on the best quarter-end tape in six years. Has rejected NVDA three times in the past two weeks. The re-entry protocol designates $200 as the gate — the market is treating it as a meaningful level.
- **★ Strongest support: $192.53** (June 26 correction low). Held on the highest-volume day of the past month (Russell reconstitution). Has not been retested since; represents the floor of the current consolidation base.

**Protocol status:** Stop Day 2 triggered on June 29 ($194.97, $0.03 below $195 stop line). Exit executed at the June 30 open per mandatory protocol. Three re-entry gates — ALL REMAIN UNCLEARED for the 9th consecutive session: (1) SPX > 7,460 ✗ closed 7,449.36 (11 pts short); (2) VIX < 17 ✗ closed 17.65; (3) NVDA > $200 on >200M shares ✗ est. close ~$198 on est. ~185M vol. NFP July 2 is the next gate-clearing catalyst; earliest viable simultaneous clearance: July 7.

**Risk:** NFP July 2 into a 3-day US holiday gap (July 4–6) means the re-entry gate cannot be tested again until July 7 at the earliest. A hot NFP print could reprice rates and re-open the VIX/SPX gates; a cold print could accelerate the $200 break. Position: cash.
